faq.q: How far is Sotogrande from Puerto Banús by boat?
faq.a: Sotogrande is about 20 nautical miles southwest of Puerto Banús. At cruising speed (20–25 knots), the trip takes roughly 50–60 minutes each way. We recommend a full-day charter (8 hours) to enjoy the polo final and the journey.

faq.q: What boats are best for a group of 10 to Sotogrande?
faq.a: For 10 guests, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Pershing 46 (10 pax) are excellent choices. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, drinks, and snacks. The Azimut 39 starts at €749/2h or €2,299/8h.

faq.q: Can we anchor near the polo field and watch from the water?
faq.a: Yes, many guests anchor in Sotogrande’s marina or nearby calm waters. However, the polo final is held at the Santa María Polo Club, which has land-based viewing. You can dock at Sotogrande Marina (pre-book a berth) and walk to the club.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

faq.q: Do you offer a jet ski with the boat rental?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants) includes a free jet ski for guests. This is ideal for extra fun during stops. Other boats can arrange jet ski rental on request.

faq.q: How early should I book for the 2027 polo final?
faq.a: The Sotogrande Polo Final typically occurs in late August. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance, as yachts are in high demand. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing.

faq.q: Can we customize the itinerary for the day?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can choose to cruise directly to Sotogrande, stop at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming, or explore the Marbella coastline. Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: Safety comes first. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and advise you 24 hours before departure.
